attributes.description: Overview of Trellix ePO On-Prem web control activity.

params.markdown:
#### Overview


This dashboard gives visibility into Trellix ePO Web Control activity, highlighting total event volume, collection trends, blocked domains, actions, reasons, and URL ratings. The time trend reflects collection time because WP_EventInfo does not provide an event timestamp. Use the Action ID, Domain, and Observer Mode controls to focus analysis and support web access monitoring and investigation.

**[Integration Page](/app/integrations/detail/trellix_epo_on_prem/overview)**
